* Dark can capture an opponent's pilot or rescue their own pilot. Light can only rescue their own pilot (Light can never capture).
* When a capital starship rescues a character stacked on this card, the rescued character is placed aboard that starship (capacity permitting). If there is insufficient capacity, the rescuing action cannot be initiated by that starship.
* When a Dark capital starship captures a Light character stacked on this card, Dark may either choose to 'seize' the character (if an escort aboard is available and capacity permits) or Dark may choose 'escape' (character goes to Light's Used Pile). Thus Dark may initiate a capture even with no escort or capacity available.
* The character can be targeted by weapons as if a starfighter, but not during battle (the character does not participate in battles). The player will need a card that allows them to fire a weapon outside of battle, such as [[Sorry About The Mess]], [[Stay Sharp!]], [[Sniper]], [[Scythe 1]], etc.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-lostinspace-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Lost In Space]]: The game text changes: “Deploy on one” becomes “If a”; “aboard a starfighter” becomes “was”; “at” becomes “from”; “system.” becomes “system or sector, deploy on that location and stack pilot here.”; “'drifts' without presence at that system (until” becomes “may be rescued or”; “or rescued” is removed; “a” becomes “any”; “starship)” becomes “starship present here during any move phase,”; “does not participate in battles or attacks, but” is removed; “starship” is removed; “(maneuver” becomes “(except during battle) as if present (treat as a starfighter with defense value”; “Lost if no pilot here.” is added after “(maneuver = 0).”. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Lost In Space” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
